integrity: Mathematical proof supported by a separately executable finite numerical and exact-rational checker; experiments are not substituted for universal arguments. Originality is assessed against accessible literature with residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Real, exactly two full-rank columns; independent standard Gaussian left sketch; only the first norm-max pivot; exact one-column orthogonal projection; expected squared Frobenius loss. The one-row comparison does not describe a full two-column CQRRPT factorization. The theorem does not cover multi-column pivoting or high-probability bounds. Earliest day-verified version of the principal 2018 RQRCP paper is 2018-04-13; the existence of an earlier 2017 conference version creates a possible earlier day-level provenance not independently established.
title: Two Gaussian sketch rows are the sharp expectation threshold for two-column pivoting
